headline: Auto Tariffs Form Key Hurdle in US-Canada Trade Negotiations
summary: Canadian and US trade officials agreed to continue talks following a Nov. 18 meeting, with automotive tariffs remaining the primary sticking point as Ottawa evaluates assistance for affected manufacturers and workers.
why: The integrated North American automotive supply chain relies on tariff-free cross-border movements governed by the USMCA trade framework.

impacts.name: North American Automotive Sector
impacts.why: Automotive tariffs threaten cross-border vehicle and parts trade between Canada and the United States.
